FROZEN_BASE.point_set: P=F_2^5\{0}, represented by integers 1..31 in binary lexical/numeric order
FROZEN_BASE.block_set: All distinct unordered triples {u,v,u+v}; canonical block representation is the sorted integer triple and blocks are sorted lexicographically
FROZEN_BASE.Levi_graph: B has one vertex for every point and block and one edge for each membership incidence

FROZEN_COVER_REPRESENTATION.orientation: Orient the 465 canonical base incidences by a deterministic base-vertex ordering.
FROZEN_COVER_REPRESENTATION.selector_output: For every oriented base edge e, output sigma_e in S_r with sigma_-e=sigma_e^{-1}.
FROZEN_COVER_REPRESENTATION.lift_vertices: (v,i) for every base vertex v and sheet i in {1,...,r}
FROZEN_COVER_REPRESENTATION.lift_edges: For each oriented base edge e:u->v and each i, connect (u,i) to (v,sigma_e(i)).
FROZEN_COVER_REPRESENTATION.required_goodness: All new adjacency eigenvalues lie in [-rho,rho], rho=sqrt(14)+sqrt(2).
FROZEN_COVER_REPRESENTATION.output_size: Theta(r) vertices/edges for the fixed 186-vertex,465-edge base, ignoring O(log r) label bits.

ONE_DOMINANT_UNPROVED_OBLIGATION.statement: Give a deterministic algorithm which, for every integer r>=1, outputs the permutation labels of an HPS-good Ramanujan r-cover of the fixed canonical STS31 Levi base in time polynomial in the produced cover encoding size.

FROZEN_SIGN_LAYER.rule: For each base point P, order its 15 incident base blocks lexicographically by the canonical block triple. Mark the first 7 base incidences POSITIVE and the remaining 8 NEGATIVE. Every lifted incidence inherits the sign of its projected base incidence.
FROZEN_SIGN_LAYER.consequence_if_cover_valid: Every lifted point/Boolean variable has exactly 7 positive and 8 negative occurrences.
FROZEN_SIGN_LAYER.independence: Signing depends only on fixed base incidence order and does not alter the incidence graph, cover spectrum, separators or treewidth.

FROZEN_CNF_ENCODING.variables: one Boolean variable for each lifted point vertex (P,i)
FROZEN_CNF_ENCODING.clauses: one 3-literal clause for each lifted block vertex (L,j), using its three lifted point neighbors and the inherited incidence signs
FROZEN_CNF_ENCODING.canonical_order: Variables lexicographic by (base_point_id,sheet_id); lifted block vertices lexicographic by (canonical_base_block_id,sheet_id); final formula passes through already-pinned canonical clause/literal serialization semantics without changing incidence/sign rules.
FROZEN_CNF_ENCODING.conditional_reducer_conclusion: Because a valid selected cover is simple C4-free (15,3)-biregular and the sign split is 7/8, the certified linear subclass applies and the exact frozen reducer returns the CNF literally unchanged in one cycle with no restart and STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT.

STRUCTURAL_CONCLUSION_IF_SELECTOR_OBLIGA.future_H1_role: Would provide a reduction-stable explicit family with residual incidence width asymptotically stronger than O(log n), subject to a separate proof/promotion gate and exact H1 scope binding.

BA16_IDENTITY_COLLAPSE_FIREWALL.prohibited_falsifier: The existence of the fixed finite quotient alone is not a legal low-width certificate.

killer_questions: Does the selector secretly restrict to an abelian/cyclic/fixed-shift lift family admitting a bounded or sublinear layout?

UPPER_BOUND_RED_TEAM_PREREGISTRATION.consistency_rule: Any genuine o(n) treewidth certificate for a graph simultaneously certified by the imported linear treewidth lemma is a proof inconsistency that must stop promotion and be resolved, not averaged away.

NEXT_SINGLE_GATE.scope: Prove or falsify only the preregistered deterministic output-polynomial selector obligation for the exact fixed STS31 Levi base. Re-run targeted literature/algorithmic binding and a fail-closed symbolic complexity proof. Do not replace the family, run SAT/reducer/treewidth sweeps, or promote H1/H2/H3 in that gate.
